story.titleZh: 发车：拉塞尔守住领跑，安东内利跌至第十七位
story.summaryZh: 梅赛德斯车队发帖通报：拉塞尔起步顺利保持领跑，安东内利则下滑一位至第十七，需要耐心向前追赶。

media.altZh: 发车：拉塞尔守住领跑，安东内利跌至第十七位 · 第 1 张

story.originalTitle: It’s light out! 🟢 George has a slot start and maintains the lead meanwhile Kimi drops a place to P17 but he will need to be patient and make his w...
story.summaryEn:
It’s light out! 🟢
George has a slot start and maintains the lead meanwhile Kimi drops a place to P17 but he will need to be patient and make his way through the field.
detailZh: “灯光熄灭，比赛开始！🟢拉塞尔起步位置不错并保持领跑，与此同时安东内利下滑一位至第十七位，但他需要保持耐心，逐步穿过车阵完成超车。”（梅赛德斯车队官方账号 @梅赛德斯AMGF1）
detailEn:
It’s light out! 🟢
George has a slot start and maintains the lead meanwhile Kimi drops a place to P17 but he will need to be patient and make his way through the field.
story.leadZh: 梅赛德斯车队发帖通报：拉塞尔起步顺利保持领跑，安东内利则下滑一位至第十七，需要耐心向前追赶。
bodyZh: 梅赛德斯车队发帖通报：拉塞尔起步顺利保持领跑，安东内利则下滑一位至第十七，需要耐心向前追赶。

relatedItems.titleZh: 安东内利8号弯惊险打滑仍列第三
relatedItems.summaryZh: 梅赛德斯车队在X上表示，安东内利在8号弯出现惊险时刻，但仍跑出17.9的成绩升至第三，拉塞尔位列第六。
relatedItems.originalTitle: A biiiig moment for Kimi at Turn 8 😅 but he still posts a 17.9 and puts himself into P3, with George P6.
relatedItems.summaryEn: A biiiig moment for Kimi at Turn 8 😅 but he still posts a 17.9 and puts himself into P3, with George P6.
detailZh: 安东内利在8号弯出现了一个惊险时刻😅，但他仍跑出17.9的成绩，将自己送入第三位，拉塞尔位列第六。
detailEn: A biiiig moment for Kimi at Turn 8 😅 but he still posts a 17.9 and puts himself into P3, with George P6.
